merge_order.reason: PR 83 established the incomplete T034-T041 reconciliation on main before PR 84 supersedes only T039; reversing the order would have landed a later artifact that still described T039 as incomplete.

reviewed_head.reason: Those workflows passed their exact tree, but the subsequent exact-diff review found four unresolved runtime defects.

review_findings.failure: Every scroll event synchronously reconciled and wrote local progress.
review_findings.repair: Throttle persistence to one pending 250 ms write and flush that pending location on pagehide, beforeunload or unmount.
review_findings.regression: throttles scroll persistence and flushes the pending location on pagehide

review_findings.failure: The lazy single-image block reserved no intrinsic geometry before anchor restoration.
review_findings.repair: Project the selected public media width and height onto the image element.
review_findings.regression: article image exposes the published 1600 by 900 intrinsic dimensions

review_findings.failure: A malformed route reused the valid fallback slug not-found for unavailable-progress cleanup.
review_findings.repair: Run unavailable cleanup only for a successfully parsed requested slug.
review_findings.regression: does not clear a real not-found article when the requested route slug is malformed

review_findings.failure: A late load event could snap a reader back to the top after they manually scrolled past the non-modal resume prompt.
review_findings.repair: Treat positive manual scrolling while the choice is pending as release of the reload guard.
review_findings.regression: treats manual scrolling as the reload-guard choice before slow assets finish

local_verification.browser_execution: NOT_RUN_LOCALLY_ENVIRONMENT_ONLY: the pinned Playwright Chromium binary is unavailable and the isolated CDN download returned truncated archives; exact-head CI is required.
